name: io.github.chrischall/remind-mcp
description: Read Remind classes, chats and messages, and manage notification settings.

environmentVariables.name: REMIND_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Captured Cookie request header from a signed-in remind.com tab. Optional: the fetchproxy bridge captures it automatically.

environmentVariables.name: REMIND_CSRF_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Captured x-csrf-token request header value. Optional; paired with REMIND_COOKIE.

environmentVariables.name: REMIND_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the cached session file. Defaults to MCP_DATA_DIR/HOME under .remind-mcp.
